title: build new <id> with no --tier writes the worker template
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the templates row of the other decisions (a new build starts as a draft from a template: invalid until every empty value is filled)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-14, shipped core and templates; docs/decisions.md D7). The default tier of `jitso build new <id>` is `worker`: the file has `tier: worker` and the printed line says `tier worker`. The oracle has no `build new` (the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so every expectation that needs the written file or the printed line FAILS on it.

stdout.equals: wrote .jitso/drafts/plain-one.yaml (tier worker, status draft): fill every empty value, check it with jitso build validate plain-one, and ask the owner to run jitso build save plain-one
